name: brand_pack_write
title: Write account Brand Studio pack
description: Create or update an account-scoped brand pack for an accessible Project: wordmark, organization, palette, fonts, tagline and optional ingested logo. Account IDs are namespaced to avoid collisions with curated packs. Brand is reusable context for programmable scenes, not a fixed visual template. Author a source scene, inspect rendered frames, and iterate before explicitly applying it to a production.

project_id.description: Project public ID; this is the account boundary for the brand pack.

brand_id.description: Requested brand id. It will be normalized/prefixed to acct-... unless already prefixed.

palette.description: Partial palette override, e.g. {background, text, accent, accent2, line}.

fonts.description: Partial typography override, e.g. {family, cssFamily, weight, letterSpacing}.

document.description: Optional full or partial identity-studio.brand.v0 document. Explicit scalar args win where supplied.

brand_pack.description: Account-scoped brand pack row with brand_id/pack_id and brand_url.
